agentFactory.mainChat.statusItems.descri: Choose which information to display and its order in the status bar settings below the chat. Drag items or use the move buttons to reorder them. An empty array hides all items.
agentFactory.mainChat.pythonPath.descrip: Python 3.10+ executable path on the extension host (without shell arguments). Empty uses python3 from PATH (python on Windows). On macOS, select your installed Python if the system Python is older.
agentFactory.mainChat.codexPath.descript: Optional absolute Codex CLI executable path on the workspace extension host (without shell arguments). Empty uses PATH, then supported NVM installations. An invalid configured path blocks startup instead of falling back.
agentFactory.mainChat.runtimeExecPath.de: Optional exec.py override for the Extension Development Host only. Normal windows always use the installed plugin cache. The F5 local plugin root takes precedence.
agentFactory.mainChat.executionMode.desc: Permissions for the next Main Agent run. The default allows full file system and network access without additional execution approval. You can restrict access to workspace writes or CLI defaults. Permissions can change between runs in the same session; the current run is unaffected.
agentFactory.mainChat.executionMode.enum: New sessions use CLI settings; existing sessions keep their saved policy.
Allow workspace writes without requesting additional approval during execution.
Allow full file system and network access without requesting additional approval during execution.
Allow full access and proceed without execution approval or plan reapproval.
